title: ML Studio 2026.11.16.2
notes:
- ML Studio remains free. Optional lifetime supporter activation (€10 or more) removes the Donate button and reminders after successful song and Visualizer exports. Activation stays valid across future updates and works offline after import.
- Settings > Menus now supports dragging entries to reorder them or move them into submenus, with drop indicators, Escape to cancel, Undo and saved per-profile layouts. Extract Chords is included in audio and pattern clip menu customization.
- Send to mixer track / Drag to Mixer is now the first action in the default audio clip menu. Mixer send knobs respond 15% faster to dragging and scrolling; Shift still provides fine adjustment.
- Audio load/CPU/memory, AI assistant, Update and Report a bug can be rearranged or removed using the toolbar editor. Existing layouts migrate without losing their saved panels. Report a bug now opens the ML Studio Discord community.
- Workspace shortcuts open with one click when a transient menu is open. Fixed missing UI symbol glyphs, replaced menu reorder arrows with drawn icons, and cleaned up the Mixer effects panel's borders and input selector.
- Console LED is the default record-light style for the Playlist and Traditional Mixer when no explicit style is saved. Existing theme choices, custom colors, size and glow remain available.
- Windows: optional Carla hosting adds 32-bit VST2 support with setup available from the app. Native 64-bit plug-ins keep their normal hosting path. Carla is not a loader for FL Studio's native-only plug-ins.
- macOS: temporary installer staging is removed after use, and abandoned installer copies are cleaned up.
